title: sed for streaming edits
intro: Work from **`/home/isopod/`**. Use **`/home/isopod/data/edits/`**. Do not edit source data in place; use **`work/`** copies for **`sed -i`**.

questions.expectedOutput:
2026-05-13T10:00:03Z ERROR postgres timeout
2026-05-13T10:00:04Z WARN retrying postgres
2026-05-13T10:00:05Z INFO recovered

questions.prompt: Filter **`/home/isopod/data/edits/db-replay.sql`** so every line containing **`DROP`** is removed. How many lines remain?
Replace every **`REDACT_ME`** with **`REDACTED`** in **`/home/isopod/data/edits/tokenized.conf`**. Paste full stdout.
**(a)** Replace only the first **`10.0.0.1`** on each line with **`192.0.2.10`** in **`/home/isopod/data/edits/ip-line.txt`**.
Redact local parts before **`@`** to **`redacted`** in **`/home/isopod/data/edits/contacts.txt`**. Keep **`@`** and domain.
questions.expectedOutput:
contact redacted@example.com please
admin redacted@corp.internal now

questions.prompt: **`/home/isopod/data/edits/flag-line.txt`** contains a single line with an embedded `MODULE05_FLAG=value` token. Extract and print only the flag value.
For **`/home/isopod/data/edits/events.log`**, append a space and **`[review]`** to the end of every line containing **`WARN`**. Other lines unchanged.
questions.expectedOutput:
INFO start
WARN disk low [review]
ERROR db down
WARN retry [review]
INFO ok

questions.prompt: Copy **`/home/isopod/data/edits/service.ini`** to **`work/service.ini`** and edit it in place so **`port=80`** becomes **`port=443`**. What does **`grep '^port=' work/service.ini`** print after the change?
questions.solutionMarkdown:
```bash
cp /home/isopod/data/edits/service.ini work/service.ini
sed -i 's/^port=80$/port=443/' work/service.ini
grep '^port=' work/service.ini
```

questions.prompt: Swap the two comma-separated fields in **`/home/isopod/data/edits/owner-queue.csv`**.
